title: dulha ki lash ran se shabbir la rahe hai
body:
dulha ki lash ran se shabbir la rahe hai
ahle haram dulhan ko bewa bana rahe hai
wo badnaseeb jo ke shab me dulhan bani thi
randsaala ka usi ko joda pinha rahe hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ghoongat ke hai jo neeche ab puchiye usi se
kya kya qayaal dil me aa aa ke jaa rahe hai
aaya jo ran se lasha chillayi umme farwa
qasim ko mere moula dulha bana rahe hai
<<DIVIDER>>
daamaad ka janaza sheh la chuke hai ghar me
ahle haram bani ka shaana hila rahe hai
sar peet'ta hai koi chilla raha hai koi
ghar ke bade dulhan ko hamraah la rahe hai
<<DIVIDER>>
shadi ka ghar to kya hai matam sara bana hai
zahra ke aur naale dil ko hila rahe hai
